New skill: **variant-check** — check a paywall variant before it gets live traffic.

Give it version A and version B (Figma frames, screenshots or a description) and the test plan (what decides it and the smallest change the test can see, e.g. from https://planner.theoutlines.xyz). It says:

- which paywall mechanics B changes (13 mechanics: trial timeline, annual as the hero, trial on annual, social proof, comparison, prices up front, multi-step, button, delayed close, visuals, price level, copy, trial added);
- whether published tests of those mechanics moved numbers enough for this test to see it, as built and if built like the winning versions;
- what the winning versions had that B lacks, each trait with its source;
- screen flags (billed price prominence, trial terms by the button, ✕);
- a short clarity pretest to run in Lyssna or Maze first.

It never forecasts a lift. QA: two rounds of two independent runs on the same three briefs; verdicts matched in every run.

One zip per skill below.
